properties.name: Kraken AD&D 2E Character Wizard
properties.author: The Kraken
properties.description: A guided character creation wizard for the AD&D 2E ruleset, inspired by the 5E character wizard. Tabbed flow: Abilities (Method V) - Race - Class (+kits) - Alignment - Equipment (starting gold + gear) - Proficiencies (weapon/specialization, languages, nonweapon) - Commit (character details + create). Single-class, level 1.

announcement.text: Kraken AD&D 2E Character Wizard v1.0-beta1 loaded. Open the Characters list and click the wizard icon to build a character.
